Impeccable Service and Food - and Wonderful Mission
Dec 2020
I'd previously been to the KOTO at Van Mieu (Temple of Literature) but that location had to close due to the lack of business from COVID-19. This new location is fantastic though!! The KOTO Villa is set in an absolutely wonderful, peaceful setting. While the address is Xuan Dieu, it's really an alley off of the busy road so you won't hear motorbikes or smell exhaust. 

The food is amazing. The new menu is excellent and while it's more limited than the previous restaurant, I'm sure that will help the business stay viable in these tough time and therefore keep the opportunities for these amazing kids alive. I had the steamed barramundi as my main dish but I also tried the macaroni and cheese and duck entrees. All we excellent. 

The staff was incredibly attentive to our every need and made the experience so wonderful. 

And for those who don't know, KOTO is an acronym for Know One-Teach One and is a program to prepare disadvantaged children for careers in the food and beverage industry. The restaurant is part of the training program.

We stayed at a 4star hotel where the food was very good and I am happy to say the food and service at Koto is even better!
